title: DoupRepoConfigFile
description: Configuration found at the root of a git repo that is to be updated by the doup dependency updater bot. (doup.{json,yaml})

plugin.description: A plugin to run, with optional plugin specific configuration.

use.description: Either a plugin package reference in wkg format (namespace:package@version) or a path to an explicit wasm module (eg: ./plugin.wasm).

with.description: An untyped property bag passed to the plugin, which is free to validate it as it wishes.

platform.description: The platform that doup will operate against, submitting pull requests with it's dependency updates. Think github, gitlab, bitbucket, etc. ONE MUST BE GIVEN.

ecosystems.description: The ecosystems of dependencies that doup will work to keep up to date. Think npm, nuget, go modules, rust crates, etc. AT LEAST ONE MUST BE GIVEN.
